title: Hearing on City employee retention strategies
summary: The Council's Civil Service and Labor Committee held an oversight hearing on October 16, 2026 examining why municipal employees leave City jobs and what agencies are doing to retain them. It reviewed DCAS and Mayor's Office of Labor Relations programs including exit surveys, a citywide employee viewpoint survey, a pay equity analysis, training initiatives and the new Jobs NYC Center. Data showed over 32,000 employees left City work in FY25, with most citing limited career advancement and pay concerns.
